title: Title screen at the 3DS's OWN geometry — the frame to diff against a console SHOT
notes: MEASURED: this configuration matches a 3DS Azahar SHOT of the same screen at 88.69% of
pixels EXACT (dE76 mean 2.02, below the ~2.3 JND). The plan's 3.1 floor -- Widescreen 0 at
320x240 -- matches the SAME console frame at only 28.46% (dE 36.05). The floor is right for
a 4:3 reference render and WRONG for a console comparison, so both live here as separate
scenarios rather than one being silently 'the' setting.
Why: the 3DS never REGISTERS gEnhancements.Graphics.Widescreen -- port/3ds/game/CMakeLists
.txt excludes gdx_menu*.cpp and the CVar stub returns the caller's default -- so the console
renders hor+ widescreen at 1, which its log confirms with [wide] hit= receipt lines. Its top
screen is 400x240, and the 320x240 mirror is a uniform 0.8 downscale of it (measured: the
content box is 48..352 on the 400-wide scanout twin and 39..282 on the mirror). Matching
that means a 400-wide window with hor+ on, not a 320-wide one with it off.
title_0300 is the PUSH START blink-OFF frame and was bit-identical across three runs; the
blink-ON frames (0450/0600/0750) agree 99.07-100%. Prefer title_0300 for any exact gate.
